cycleRule: only run after multifeature periodicity is supported; local principal-waveform maximum, >=2 family support, >=0.6 period separation

featureFamilies.definition: mean width of the central low-intensity interval at normalized depths 0.36, 0.48, 0.60
featureFamilies.exclusions: requires at least two valid depths and brighter support on both sides
featureFamilies.name: central_shadow_geometry
featureFamilies.semanticClaim: dark central morphology only; no bone or vertebra identity
featureFamilies.threshold: 0.55 times the lateral band median, clipped to [0.10, 0.46]

featureFamilies.definition: outer-minus-inner depth of twelve fixed-x bright-to-dark ridge samples
featureFamilies.name: bright_interface_geometry
featureFamilies.semanticClaim: bright interface geometry only; not assumed to be bone
featureFamilies.threshold: ridge score >= 0.18; at least four samples per side

featureFamilies.definition: correlation of mirrored fixed lateral ROIs over normalized depths 0.18 to 0.70
featureFamilies.name: bilateral_structure

imageNormalization: grayscale 256x256; robust 2nd/98th percentile normalization in fixed ROI

periodicity.reason: 6-36 mm-class recurrence search at approximately 3 mm sampling without using reference spacing
